Photograph looking straight up from beneath an old Japanese maple tree (Acer palmatum) toward a bright white overcast sky. Hundreds of delicate seven-pointed star-shaped leaves in dark silhouette, some layers glowing translucent green where light passes through, thin dark twisting branches reaching in from the left and top edges. The canopy is dense on the left half and top of the frame and opens to bright empty white sky toward the lower right. High contrast, crisp leaf edges, no sun, no lens flare, no text, no watermark.

Editorial interior photograph of a quiet ground-floor room in a traditional Kyoto ryokan. Pale green tatami mats, a low dark wooden table with a single ceramic tea cup, a folded futon with undyed linen, sliding shoji screens pulled fully open onto a narrow engawa veranda of weathered cedar boards, beyond it a lush moss garden with a mossy stone lantern and the dark green edge of a koi pond. Soft diffused morning light, faint mist, deep shadows inside the room. Serene, minimal, luxurious, Kinfolk / Cereal magazine style, 35mm film photograph, natural grain, no people, no text, no watermark.

Editorial interior photograph of a traditional Kyoto ryokan room in late autumn. Tatami floor, a low lacquered table, a round hinoki cedar soaking tub by an open window, sliding shoji screens framing an old Japanese maple tree blazing vermilion and crimson that overhangs a dark koi pond, fallen red leaves floating on the water. Warm late-afternoon light through the leaves casts dappled red light across the tatami. Editorial interior photograph of the upper room of a traditional Kyoto ryokan at night. A tatami room lit only by a glowing paper andon floor lamp, shoji opened onto a small wooden moon-viewing platform built out over a koi pond. A full moon hangs in a deep blue night sky above dark pine and maple silhouettes and its reflection sits perfectly in the still black water below. Two zabuton cushions and a tray with a sake flask on the platform.
